title: Kutenda Kwakavanzika Mukati Memasvingo Emuzinda
intro: Pakati pedare rine hutsinye rakazara nepfungwa dzekuzvikudza, mweya wega une chakavanzika chine njodzi. Akakomberedzwa nesimba uye kutyisidzira kwerufu, muranda uyu waAllah anoona mutumwa achimira ega achirwisa umambo. Kana kunyarara kwava kubatana, sarudzo yakasimba inofanira kuitwa yekutaura chokwadi panjodzi huru yemunhu.
clues: Ndakagara pakati pevanhu vane simba uye vanozvikudza vakaramba zviratidzo zvaAllah.
Ndakavanza kutenda kwangu kwenguva yakati apo avo vakanga vakandipoteredza vaironga kurwisa mutumwa.
Ndakataura pachena, ndichiti: Unouraya munhu here nekuti vanoti, Ishe wangu ndiAllah, ukuwo humbowo hwakajeka hwasvika?
Ndakanyevera vanhu vangu nezveramangwana remarudzi ekare uye nezveZuva reKudanana.
Ndakavaudza kuti mutongi wandaishandira anongova nepfungwa dzakapfava, asi Hupenyu hunotevera ndiwo musha chaiwo.
Ndakati: Imi vanhu vangu, nditeverei uye ndichakutungamirirai munzira yakarurama, uye Allah vakandiponesa kubva muzvakaipa zvehurongwa hwavo hwekuronga.

trial.label: Ndakaitei?
options: Pfuma yakaunganidzwa ine makiyi airemedza varume vane simba
Akavaka shongwe refu kuti atarire mwari waMusa
Kutenda kwakavanzika kwakabva kwadzivirira Mosesi pachena ndokunyevera vanhu vangu
Akagadzira mhuru yegoridhe yaiita ruzha rukuru
Akavhara nzira yeMuporofita uye akaseka zvakazarurwa zvepfuma
trial.answer: Kutenda kwakavanzika kwakabva kwadzivirira Mosesi pachena ndokunyevera vanhu vangu

outcome.label: Chii Chakaitika Kwangu?
options: Ndakanyura pamwe chete neuto mugungwa rakakamurwa
Mheni yakabata ini pamwe chete naThamud
Mwari vakandidzivirira kubva muzvakaipa zvezano ravo
outcome.answer: Mwari vakandidzivirira kubva muzvakaipa zvezano ravo

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
